title: Readout Orientation Controls Measurement-Accessible Quantum Tangent Geometry
summary: A fixed quantum measurement can expose substantially more tangent information than a restricted observable readout retains. We study this second restriction. For a normalized covariance $C \succeq 0$, $\mathrm{Tr} C = 1$, of measurement-induced tangent scores in an $N$-dimensional centered score space, and a rank-$r$ readout projector $P$, we quantify retained tangent mass by $R=\mathrm{Tr}(PC)$.
